name: The harness digest covers the gate command, and is unchanged when none is handed in
description: Three passing runs differed only by no gate command, gate-a and gate-b. The no-command self-check digest matched SHA-256 of the configuration bytes, self-check command text and probe bytes in order; all three runs recorded distinct harness digests.
